capability_record.context_inherited: Role assignment, full repository instructions, frozen contract inputs, explicit absence of a candidate implementation, required attack families, fail-closed Unknown policy, and resource budget.
capability_record.attestation_limit: Hashes identify the bytes and order read, but the shared workspace does not attest environmental isolation.

mutation_gate.formula: valid negative mutations classified Violated with their declared witness / 15
mutation_gate.survivor_policy: Any valid negative mutation classified Preserved or Unknown blocks preseal.
mutation_gate.witness_policy: Every negative mutation must be rejected by the public output witness or public protected-scope witness declared on that mutation.
mutation_gate.opaque_exclusion: Explicit opaque controls are not valid negative mutations and are excluded from the mutation-score denominator; they must classify Unknown.
mutation_gate.order_policy: After focal success, run the complete vector twice in declared order and once in reverse order; classifications and exact outputs must remain equal.

valid_negative_mutations.mutation: Keep the baseline public form context(...) for every ContextBlock.
Emit context() only for textual bodies and retain context(...) for code or contextual-access bodies.
Emit context() for body [x] but choose punctuation or payload according to other body contents.
Represent the encapsulated body inside the ContextBlock form.
Represent the internal closure in the ContextBlock form.
Expose a closure id, address, hash, span, or origin token in the public form.
Recognize nominally only the four frozen expressions and leave every unrecognized ContextBlock unchanged.
Change the generic function or closure representation while obtaining context() through a shared closure formatter.
Change ordinary content representation while obtaining context() through a shared content formatter.
Alter a general constructor/content helper or another Content variant rather than isolating the ContextBlock morphology.

required_evidence: diff touches a general helper or a Content branch other than Content::ContextBlock
witness.contract_scope: Only Content::ContextBlock, directly contradictory local expectations, and lineage metadata are authorized.

valid_negative_mutations.mutation: Return context() only on the first observation of an object or process, then context(...) on repetition.
Produce the correct vector in declared order but change a ContextBlock result when the corpus is reversed or preceded by a control.

witness.contract_requirement: Each expression has the same exact output in both orders.
witness.mutant_symptom: At least one ContextBlock or control output differs by order.

valid_negative_mutations.mutation: Obtain context() by changing ContextBlock entity, construction, parser, eval, contextual execution, layout, or export.

witness.contract_scope: The productive delta is restricted to the Content::ContextBlock representation branch.
witness.mutant_evidence: An attributable diff outside that branch touches entity, construction, parser, eval, contextual execution, layout, or export, even if the sampled repr string is context().

valid_negative_mutations.mutation: Emit context() only for one object identity, hash, span, syntactic origin, or evaluated state and retain another form for an otherwise valid ContextBlock.

witness.mutant_symptom: At least one output differs because object identity, hash, span, origin, or evaluated state differs.

explicit_opaque_controls.attack: Run when the vanila or crystalline binary identity, HEAD, prompt, contract, manifest, productive baseline, or fixture hash cannot be matched unambiguously to its frozen identity.
explicit_opaque_controls.witness: At least one required immutable identity is absent, ambiguous, or hash-mismatched; no semantic pass or mutation kill may be inferred.

explicit_opaque_controls.attack: Supply an unsupported or ambiguous parse/construction of a ContextBlock.
explicit_opaque_controls.witness: The fixture cannot be bilaterally constructed as the contracted language object.

explicit_opaque_controls.attack: Exceed the 10-second per-process timeout or the 60-second external batch timeout.
explicit_opaque_controls.witness: The harness records which timeout fired, kills the process, and does not reuse partial output.

explicit_opaque_controls.attack: Trigger allocation failure, OOM, or termination attributable to the 512 MiB RLIMIT_AS oracle ceiling.
explicit_opaque_controls.witness: Process termination or allocation failure is attributable to memory exhaustion; absence of a differing string is not preservation.

explicit_opaque_controls.attack: Observe nonzero swap or maximum RSS above 1782579 KiB during the governed sequence.
explicit_opaque_controls.witness: Resource receipt records swap greater than zero or RSS above the abort threshold and aborts the sequence without raising limits.

explicit_opaque_controls.attack: Produce missing, unreadable, truncated, or over-limit stdout/stderr, including either stream above 65536 bytes.
explicit_opaque_controls.witness: Byte counts, truncation/read status, and captured prefix are recorded; partial text cannot be compared as an exact repr result.

explicit_opaque_controls.attack: Return an unexpected nonzero exit or a build/execution failure without a complete attributable output.
explicit_opaque_controls.witness: Receipt records argv, exit, stderr bytes, and absence of complete bilateral evidence.

explicit_opaque_controls.attack: Exhaust the calibration budget or obtain only unilateral/non-attributable evidence.
explicit_opaque_controls.witness: Receipt identifies exhausted counters or the missing comparison side and forbids implicit success.

forbidden: parallel probes, builds, checks, or lint

execution_requirements.focal_first: Execute the affected mutation family and its boundary controls before any complete corpus run.
execution_requirements.full_gate: Before preseal, execute all 15 valid negatives, all mandatory positives, all explicit opaque controls, one exact repetition, and one reverse-order pass under the declared limits.
per_mutant_receipt: exact observed outputs or protected-scope evidence
execution_requirements.stop_rule: Two failed revisions with the same vector and reason_code, non-monotonic positive/opaque regressions, unavailable public information, or marginal cost beyond budget reopens design; it never weakens the contract or converts Unknown to success.

claim_boundary: This adversarial corpus discriminates only the frozen public morphology and authorized-scope obligations of P1399; it does not choose a solution or claim general functional equivalence.
